title: The 5 Best Dehumidifiers for Basements
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for dehumidifiers for basements, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dehumidifiers for basements using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Frigidaire FFAP5033W1 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day moisture removal, 4,500 sq ft coverage, Built-in condensate pump for upward continuous drainage, 1.8-gallon washable-filter bucket with splash guard.
strengths: Built-in pump pushes water up and out through a hose, no more hauling a full bucket up basement stairs
41°F operating floor keeps working through a cool basement winter, where many competitors ice over
Washable filter is a five-minute rinse rather than a replacement purchase
limitations: 1.8-gallon bucket fills fast if the pump hose isn't connected
Front display can be hard to read the current humidity number in a dim basement
Casters are small and can struggle on uneven concrete flooring
features: Built-in condensate pump for upward continuous drainage
Energy Star certified, 24-hour timer, custom humidity control

products.name: Midea Cube 35-Pint Smart Dehumidifier with Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 35-pint-per-day rating, covers up to 3,500 sq ft, Lift-and-twist Cube design triples effective tank capacity when extended, Wi-Fi control via the MideaAir app, works with Alexa.
strengths: Extended Cube tank holds roughly 3x a standard bucket, cutting how often it needs emptying
App control lets you check basement humidity and tank status without walking downstairs
Quietest compressor of the models in this roundup per independent lab comparisons
Draws meaningfully less power than other 50-pint-class units at the same humidity setting
limitations: 35-pint rating means it works harder than a 50-pint unit in a very damp basement
Costs more than the Vremi or TOSOT at typical street pricing
Learning to retract and extend the Cube tank takes a try or two
features: 35-pint-per-day rating, covers up to 3,500 sq ft
Lift-and-twist Cube design triples effective tank capacity when extended
Wi-Fi control via the MideaAir app, works with Alexa
Built-in pump with included drain hose

products.name: TOSOT 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Internal Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day rating for up to 4,500 sq ft, Internal pump lifts water up to 15 feet through an included 19-foot hose, 52-decibel peak sound level.
strengths: 15-foot pump lift covers basements where gravity drainage to a floor drain isn't an option
52dB peak volume is genuinely quiet for a 50-pint compressor
Auto-restart after a power blip matters in a basement that isn't checked daily
limitations: Owner reports of compressor failures after 2 to 3 summers are more common than with Frigidaire
Bucket-full sensor is sensitive and occasionally stops the unit with tank space remaining
Control panel buttons feel less durable than the housing around them
features: 50-pint-per-day rating for up to 4,500 sq ft
Internal pump lifts water up to 15 feet through an included 19-foot hose
Energy Star certified and UL listed
Auto-restart resumes the previous setting after a power outage

products.name: Vremi 50-Pint Dehumidifier for 4,500 Sq Ft Spaces
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day rating for spaces up to 4,500 sq ft, 1.8-gallon tank with built-in handle and full-tank auto shut-off, Adjustable humidistat, 24-hour timer, continuous drain hose option.
strengths: Lowest typical street price of the 50-pint units in this roundup
Caster wheels make it easy to roll between a basement and a laundry room
Continuous drain hose option removes bucket-emptying entirely
limitations: Compressor runs louder than the Midea Cube or TOSOT at the same setting per owner reports
Plastic housing feels less substantial than the Frigidaire
Shorter warranty coverage than Frigidaire or Midea
features: 50-pint-per-day rating for spaces up to 4,500 sq ft
1.8-gallon tank with built-in handle and full-tank auto shut-off
Adjustable humidistat, 24-hour timer, continuous drain hose option

products.name: ALORAIR Sentinel HDi65S Crawlspace Dehumidifier
strengths: Low profile fits tight crawl spaces
limitations: Capacity ratings vary by test standard
Needs professional-style install for best results

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
